headlines.title: Attack on Riyadh airport killed 12 people and wounded over 300 more, Saudi authorities say
headlines.summary: Saudi authorities say the latest attack on the international airport in the capital, Riyadh, has killed 12 people and injured over 300. Their statement says the dead on Saturday included four Saudi citizens as well as two Bangladeshi nationals, a Palestinian, a U.S. citizen, an Egyptian, a Jordanian, a Syrian and a Sudanese. It said some of those injured were in critical condition. The attack — the latest of several in the past week on King Khalid International Airport — is expected to increase Saudi pressure on allies including the United States to provide military support for the kingdom.

headlines.title: China, EU agree on steps to stabilize trade ties
headlines.summary: China and the European Union have agreed on a package of measures to ease trade frictions, improve market access and strengthen the stability of industrial and supply chains, according to a joint statement released by China's Ministry of Commerce on Friday, as the two sides sought to manage differences and build a more stable and balanced economic relationship.
